name: herdr-brain
description: Herdr Monitor: a durable record of work items, runs, reports and zero-inference status outside any LLM session.

scripts.test:promotion: node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion -- npm run test:promotion:steps
scripts.test: npm run test:slot && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:core --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:core && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:cycle --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:cycle
scripts.test:promotion:steps: npm run test:slot && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:core --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:core && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:lanes --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:lanes && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:logic --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:logic
scripts.test:promotion:logic: node test/helpers/run.mjs --test-name-pattern='^(measured load|a loaded native lookup|the default native executor|the record lock|exhausted record-lock|exhausted, refused|a replacement PID|slow Herdr|housekeeping gives|queue and notice locks|inbox fixture teardown|owned inbox teardown|(?:exhausted|refused) (?:start|prepare|commit) replies|loaded transaction|provider selection|alternative profiles|entry reserves|(?:claude|codex): captured ANSI|compound styles|Codex includes|interruption requires|repository does not track)' test/load-deadlines.test.mjs settle/test/ref-deadlines.test.mjs discovery/test/alternatives.test.mjs discovery/test/validation-deadlines.test.mjs supervisor/test/delivery.test.mjs housekeeping/test/housekeeping.test.mjs supervisor/test/entry.test.mjs
